artNote: No row carries a picture. The chapter’s own drawings are deferred with the rest of this unit’s design, and none of these thirteen rows needs one: every question turns on a word, a form or a date, all of which a row of buttons can print. If pictures are drawn later the obvious four are 떡국 and 송편 for rows 3 and 9, the 세배 bow for row 11 and the five yut throws for row 13 — the same drawings the 교과서’s 어휘 and 과제 pages are waiting on, so they should be made once and used in both.

questions.q: Which of the chapter’s four patterns says a thing was done early and is still done?

choices.A: The one that was actually used
choices.B: The one that was not used

questions.q: Which of these is a plan the speaker might still change their mind about?

choices.D: a report of something already finished

questions.q: 설날 is said [설랄]. What has happened to it?

choices.A: The ㄹ has become a ㄴ
choices.B: The ㄴ has become a ㄹ

questions.q: Which word means a traditional holiday rather than just a run of days off?
